claims: This class examines a responsum by Haham Matloub Abadi regarding the placement of Kaddish during the Shacharit service on Tisha BeAb. - The speaker repeatedly mentions Haham Obadiah, not Haham Matloub Abadi.
summary: This class examines a responsum by Haham Matloub Abadi regarding the placement of Kaddish during the Shacharit service on Tisha BeAb. It explores whether the third ole should recite Kaddish before or after the Haftara by comparing the custom of Egypt with the established customs of Halab.
questions: Should the third ole recite Kaddish before or after the Haftara on Tisha BeAb?
Is Kaddish considered an interruption between the Torah reading and the Haftara?
What was the custom of Egypt regarding Kaddish on Tisha BeAb?
How does the custom of Halab compare to other practices regarding Kaddish on Tisha BeAb?
